messages:
nora: Quick follow-up from the cache outage postmortem — proposing a small set of "follow-up guardrails" so action items don't disappear after PM close. Basic pieces: short SLA by priority, escrow (backup) owner, required verification artifact (dashboard/PR), and an explicit IC handoff checklist. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

pete: +1. Can we make verification required to close? e.g., a dashboard snapshot link or a canary job PR. If no proof, bot reopens the action. Keeps things accountable. :thumbsup:

li: Suggestion for SLA windows: P0 = 72h, P1 = 7d, P2 = 21d. If the primary misses expiry, escrow becomes owner and bot pings the oncall channel. That transition should be automatic.

harry: For recurring patterns: tag incidents with a recurrence key derived from service + error fingerprint. If key appears 3x in 45d, auto-open a "recurrence review" epic and add a short summary line in the new postmortem: "N occurrences in Xd, likely bucket: <short>". That helps triage long-term work.

nora: Minimal escrow card schema (draft):
```
owner: @<owner>
escrow: @<backup>
priority: P0/P1/P2
escrow_expiry: YYYY-MM-DD
verify_artifact: <dashboard link or PR>
recurrence_key: <service:error-hash>
blockers: free-text
notes: rollback/flag/plan link
```

pete: Add IC-observer to the card so the next oncall can review open escrows during handoff. Observer should check escrows >48h and nudge owners. Add a one-line "handoff note" field too.

li: Comms cadence: when an escrow card is created, bot posts one-line to #eng-oncall and the service channel: "Action <id> — owner — ETA — blocker". Then concise progress updates every 72h until closed. Also a weekly digest to SRE leads with open escrows >7d and recurrence candidates.

ops-bot: [reminder] Action 2290001234-1 due in 24h — pinging escrow @li.

harry: Automation idea: if a recurrence key hits threshold, the recurrence-review epic should include the last 3 postmortem summaries and the shared stack trace hash. Also set a 2-week SLA for that epic and loop in product.

nora: Next steps: (1) pete will create a pilot board and card template (due Fri), (2) li will add IC-observer and handoff note to oncall playbook (due Mon), (3) harry will prototype recurrence-keyer and escalation rule (due Tue), (4) nora will wire bot announcements + weekly digest (due Tue). Quick 20-min demo mid-next-week.

pete: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/remediation-pilot/pull/42 — includes card schema and reminder webhook. Feedback appreciated.

li: I'll update the playbook and leave a short checklist for IC handoffs: summary, open escrows, recurrence flags, and immediate blockers.

nora: Thanks team — pilot infra-only for 3 weeks, keep one-line updates here: "Action <id> — owner — status". Goal: fewer dropped follow-ups and faster identification of recurring failures. :rocket:
